== Japanese printing source review ==
Original Japanese title, lore, game text, subtype, destiny, title marks and icons were read from [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Charming-To-The-Last-PSA-20261106.jpg|the original photograph]]. Rarity is from the Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 Japanese checklist, p.97. English reading aids were prepared by ChatGPT against this photograph and [[:File:Premiere-D-charmingtothelast.gif|the English printed face]]. The Japanese title describes continued bravery rather than charm. Both game texts require Tarkin and a Rebel with ability > 2 in the same battle and give one additional battle destiny, or two for Leia. The Japanese lore says the information was given up easily and promises to destroy the Rebel friends; the English says “You're far too trusting” and “We will deal with your Rebel friends soon enough.” No Credits field is printed. Photo SHA-256: 5589cd3b1010b199fa2051677d5596b2bcc400940782023fea3a99ac2a1346db. Source preservation is pending; no unverified archive link is supplied.
